name: pdf-ceviri
description: PDF dosyalarini tamamen Turkceye ceviren web uygulamasi (Claude API)

scripts.model: node scripts/mt-fetch-corpus.js --corpus ted --out korpus.tsv --holdout 1000 --dev-out data/dev.tsv && node scripts/mt-train-parallel.js --tsv korpus.tsv --out model.json --workers 4 --iter 10 --mincount 2 --stem --gzip && node scripts/mt-eval.js --model model.json.gz --dev data/dev.tsv
scripts.model-kalite: node scripts/mt-fetch-corpus.js --corpus wikimatrix,opensubtitles,ted --out korpus.tsv --limit 1200000 --holdout 2000 --dev-out data/dev.tsv && node scripts/mt-train-stream.js --tsv korpus.tsv --out model.json --batch 30000 --iter 8 --maxphrase 6 --mincount 2 --segment --gzip && node scripts/mt-tune.js --model model.json.gz --dev data/dev.tsv --metric chrf --save && node scripts/mt-eval.js --model model.json.gz --dev data/dev.tsv
